# Windows x64 core build provenance

[33189661783](https://github.com/loganpendragonmultiverse/forge-emulation/actions/runs/33189661783)
from the exact commits recorded below. The workflow checks each Git checkout before
compilation and is itself pinned to an immutable MSYS2 setup action commit.
